Build a lesson Q&A web app in `user-apps/lesson-qa` on top of Smart Classroom's
Content Search:

- A teacher uploads lesson materials (PDF, slides, images, short videos) and sees
  each file's indexing status until it is ready.
- Students type questions and get answers grounded in those materials, with the
  source documents and relevance scores listed under each answer.
- Follow-up questions keep the conversation history.

Show me the plan first: the pipeline diagram, which Intel runtime and device each
stage uses, and the files you'll create.
